key: When the dimmer takes the display down, the screen frosts over and the countdown glows in the middle of it. Both are switches beside the dimming controls.

key: When the work stops, your Mac sleeps as it always did. Your sleep settings are never changed.

key: When you step away at night and macOS would have turned the display off, Belay dims it to this level instead. It brightens again when you return.
